contract_name: Collector First-Year Breakout and Entry-Timing Contract
purpose: Identify recently released Collector Booster boxes while attractive entry opportunity remains, rather than only after most appreciation has occurred.

historical_evidence_availability_policy.principle: A feature may be used in a historical replay only when its value and observation timestamp can be supported for that checkpoint.
prohibited_interpretations: UNAVAILABLE_AT_CHECKPOINT must not be treated as zero.
SOURCE_NOT_YET_OPERATING must not be treated as no supply or no demand.
OBSERVATION_TIMESTAMP_UNVERIFIED must not be used as point-in-time evidence.
Current marketplace observations must not be backfilled into historical checkpoints.

model_lane_policy.core_replay_lane: Uses only features broadly and credibly available across historical checkpoints.
model_lane_policy.enhanced_replay_lane: Uses additional point-in-time supply-demand evidence where supported.
model_lane_policy.current_production_lane: May use the full certified current feature set, but must not claim historical validation for features absent from replay history.
model_lane_policy.selection_rule: Candidate models compete only within compatible evidence-availability cohorts; broader-feature models must prove incremental value on checkpoints where those features exist.

selection_principles: Correct eventual winner classification is insufficient if the signal arrives after most appreciation.
The winning model must identify most historical first-year breakout boxes before the major move.
Late confirmation must not be represented as early discovery.
A strong product may still receive OPPORTUNITY_MOSTLY_REALIZED at the current price.
Forecast accuracy and investment discovery quality must both be measured.
No fixed model weights are required; candidates compete through out-of-sample replay.
Unavailable historical supply-demand evidence must reduce feature coverage, not become invented values.
A model using richer current evidence must not claim the same historical validation as a model tested on a narrower replay feature set.
